leads.name: Ginkgo of Shimono Hachiman Shrine (下野八幡宮のイチョウ)
leads.reason: no photo or exact pin in reach: no open-licence photo on Commons/Openverse and no OSM tree node; shrine-level pin only (OSM node 5089460578). Otherwise strong: national natural monument (designated 1951-06-09), female tree, girth 9.20 m at breast height, height 36.40 m, per the Agency for Cultural Affairs (https://online.bunka.go.jp/heritages/region/45/45441); about 800 years per the town; selected for Miyazaki's 100 giant trees; stands left of the approach. A photograph of it from Hidde or a reader would open it.

leads.name: Zelkova of Shimono Hachiman Shrine (下野八幡宮のケヤキ)
leads.reason: no photo or exact pin in reach, as for the ginkgo. National natural monument (1951-06-09): root girth 20.80 m, breast-height girth 8 m, height 34.70 m, crown spread 26 by 33 m, stands against the shrine building on the right (Agency for Cultural Affairs, 文化遺産オンライン). Probably the best tree in Takachiho by record; needs a photograph.

leads.name: Sakasa-sugi and Arima-sugi, Shimono Hachiman Shrine
leads.reason: no photo or exact pin; about 800 and 400 years by the planting legends on a travel site and the town page; neither is designated, no measurements.

leads.name: Sacred zelkova of Kushifuru Shrine (槵觸神社)
leads.reason: no photo or exact pin; the 'about 3,000 years' is a shrine-guide claim (kyushu-jinja.com) with no measurement, treat as legend; shrine is a town tangible cultural property (1990). Commons has Kushifuru-jinjya.jpg 45 m from the shrine node but it was not checked as showing the tree.
